speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. To begin our investigation into your acute diarrhea, please tell me how many times you have had a loose or watery bowel movement in the last 24 hours and if you have noticed any blood or mucus in your stool.

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-associated diarrhea (likely *C. difficile* infection).

You were recently treated with levofloxacin, a fluoroquinolone known to disrupt gut flora and cause *C. difficile* infection. I need to confirm if you have experienced recent hospitalization or nursing home stay, and I will request a stool test to confirm. REQUEST TEST: Stool_C_diff_toxin_assay. REQUEST TEST: Electrolytes.
